documents.purpose: Earth's Minnaert limb coefficient at 680 nm (red channel), measured from DSCOVR EPIC full-disc frames, used to light the globe.

references.evidence: Fitted by tools/photometry/fit-epic-limb.mts to the 680 nm Image and per-pixel Sun and view angles of six 2023 Level 1B v03 frames (epic_1b_20230201020554_03, epic_1b_20230401061002_03, epic_1b_20230601000831_03, epic_1b_20230801144729_03, epic_1b_20231002185542_03, epic_1b_20231201220341_03), read from https://avdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/pub/DSCOVR/Level1b_v03/2023/. Mean k 0.394, frame-to-frame spread 0.066; per-frame fits and bin residuals are in src/objects/earth/evidence/epic-limb-fit.json. Bins with cosines below 0.1 are left out, so the law is held at 84.3 degrees.
